verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "Exportable audit logs" as a top-tier feature. Its publishing docs describe feature revisions published with commit messages and a Revision dropdown for reverting, which together imply recorded flag change history. Neither source documents what an audit entry contains (actor, timestamp, before/after value), so only the existence of the capability is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation that each entry records who, what, when and the new value; proof that every flag change (including API toggles) is logged; independent or hands-on corroboration; availability below the top paid tier.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value

citations.quote: Continue adding changes to the draft, and when you're ready, publish them all at once with an optional commit message.
To undo changes and revert to a previous state, use the **Revision** dropdown to select the version you want to revert to, then click **Revert**.
